findings.claim: MSCI FY2025 10-K 風險因素：關稅、報復性關稅與貿易緊張可能影響投資人配置與客戶預算、延後或取消訂閱；地緣與貿易政策變動可能限制其在特定司法管轄區提供產品、取得營運所需技術，或降低需求；亦受出口管制、制裁等法規約束。
findings.excerpt: Our business is impacted by economic conditions, including economic uncertainty, market downturns and volatility in the global capital markets and evolving investment trends (including volatility and trends resulting from geopolitical events and trade policy changes, including tariffs, retaliatory tariffs and related trade tensions).
